intro:
A **45-minute** timed test on the whole of Kinematics — motion language, position-time graphs, velocity-time graphs, acceleration-time graphs, the constant-acceleration equations, one-dimensional free fall, and vector components. It is **generated fresh every time you open it**: a new set of questions drawn from across the unit, in a new order, with the answer choices shuffled.

The mix follows the Physics Academy test blueprint (`docs/test-generation.md`) — the same difficulty target used in every course. BASIS Physics 8 is a pre-AP course, so every item stays within one-dimensional motion, but the reasoning is held to AP Physics 1 rigor: the median question sits at the standard level and about a third are at or above the stretch line.

**No calculator.** Every multiple-choice item is built to be solved by hand. Multiple choice is scored automatically; free response is scored by you against the model answer and rubric.
